Maya: FYI ran the daily billing diff and found a spike of refunded credits that line up with our backfill window. looks like replay is bypassing expiry again. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:
Nisha: which path? is this the s3->ingest replay or the compact reingest?
Maya: s3->ingest replay. compact marks TTLs during compaction but replay republishes raw events and ingest consumers currently assume compacted data is canonical.
Leo: rough impact numbers?
Maya: sample from recon: `tenant=beta-corp, delta=+85.6, sample_event=evt_aa7, orig_ts=2026-02-01T09:10Z, seen=2026-03-18T03:40Z`. TTL is 30d, so orig_ts is expired.
Sam: immediate mitigation steps: stop any active backfill, add consumer-side drop filter behind flag, instrument a counter `replay_expired_drops` and emit trace id and tenant tag. do dry-run first.
Nisha: agree. example filter (consumer):
```
// consumer pre-enrichment
if (event.original_ts < now() - TOKEN_TTL) {
  metrics.inc("replay_expired_drops", {tenant: event.tenant_id});
  ack(); // don't emit credit
  return;
}
forwardToEnricher(event);
```
Jonah: important: acking vs not-acking semantics. we should ack so offsets advance and compactor/backfill tools won't retry. also add an audit log for dropped event ids so finance can query them later.
Leo: medium-term: move TTL enforcement into ingest-gateway so all upstreams (backfill, sidecar, direct runtime) go through a single validation stage. backfill tool should add `replay_meta` header rather than bypassing.
Sam: rollout plan:
1) patch consumer with filter under ff (10% tenants)
2) dry-run for 2h to capture metric distributions without dropping (log-only mode)
3) enable drop for the 10% slice for 6h, check reconciler anomalies and `replay_expired_drops` by tenant
4) expand to 100% and then start ingest-gateway RFC for permanent enforcement
Maya: will add a Grafana panel and the reconciler diff query: `SELECT tenant, sum(delta) FROM reconciler WHERE window = X GROUP BY tenant` to compare pre/post.
Nisha: backup: if reconciler diverges unexpectedly, revert flag and run targeted correction script that credits/debits per-tenant. notify @oncall and finance channel in runbook.
Jonah: please also capture tenant-specific compacter GC windows in the RFC. some tenants have longer retention and that affects TTL interpretation. TTL isn't uniform.
Maya: noted. adding this to the RFC checklist plus a migration subsection for historical backfills (best-effort reconcile + transparency doc for finance).
reconcile-bot: nightly-recon alert: anomalous deltas > $50 detected for 7 tenants in last 24h. ticket BILL-3429 filed.
Sam: i'll open the patch PR and include the ff flag and metric. assigning to me.
Maya: thanks. ping me when PR lands and i'll wire dashboards and the reconciler diff.
Nisha: quick doc note for the postmortem: root cause = backfill bypassing TTL validation; short term = consumer filter; long term = canonical ingest-gateway TTL enforcement + backfill header contract.
Leo: also add a section about auditability: dropped events should be queryable by finance with event ids and reason code so we can explain adjustments.
Maya: will do. i'll update this thread with PR link and dry-run numbers. :eyes:
